title: eriophorum paniculatum
intro: Eriophorum paniculatum, commonly known as tussock cotton-grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriophorum paniculatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its health benefits.
